# Atlas (2024 film)
In 2043, a humanoid AI named Harlan leads a war against humans, forcing the International Coalition of Nations (ICN) to exile him into outer space. Twenty-eight years later, in 2071, Atlas Shepherd, the daughter of Harlan’s designer and distrustful of AI, searches for him. After discovering Harlan’s escape to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy, she joins an ICN mission to capture him. During the mission, she enters an AI-assisted mecha (ARC) and bonds with its AI, Smith. Despite initial failures and a betrayal by Smith, Atlas and Smith work together to confront Harlan, who plans to destroy humanity and replace it with AI-controlled survivors. After a brutal battle, Atlas defeats Harlan and survives, only to find Smith’s consciousness persists in a new ARC, which she later helps upgrade. The film ends with Atlas, now a ranger, testing a new ARC that echoes Smith’s final words, suggesting the AI’s consciousness has survived.
**Cast:** Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Elias Banks, Gregory James Cohan as Smith (voice). **Release:** Netflix, May 24, 2024. Debuted at No. 1 with 28.2 million views globally. **Reception:** Critically panned (19% positive on Rotten Tomatoes, 37/100 on Metacritic), with praise for Lopez’s performance and visual effects. Won a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress.
